requirement_text: The application shall be fully loaded and ready to use within a maximum of 2 seconds after startup.
requirement_reference: "it is fully loaded and ready to use within a maximum of two seconds after starting."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want the app to load within 2 seconds so that I can use it without delay.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the app is installed on a supported device
When I start the app
Then the app is fully loaded and ready to use within 2 seconds.

requirement_text: The application shall run quickly and smoothly on supported Android and iOS devices.
requirement_reference: "It is particularly important to us that the app runs quickly and smoothly"

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want the app to run quickly and smoothly so that my experience feels responsive.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given I am using a supported mobile device
When I navigate and interact with the app
Then the app responds smoothly without noticeable performance issues.

requirement_text: The live ticker data display shall update in real time.
requirement_reference: "retrieve the live results of their favorite teams in real time" / "display of live data in real time"

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want live ticker updates in real time so that I can trust the timeliness of match information.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a live match is ongoing
When live match data changes on the source system
Then the displayed live ticker data is updated in real time.

requirement_text: The system shall serve up to 100,000 concurrent users without performance loss.
requirement_reference: "our app is designed so that up to 100,000 users can be served simultaneously without performance loss."

user_story.user_story:
As a business stakeholder, I want the app to support 100,000 simultaneous users without performance loss so that match-day demand can be handled reliably.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given 100,000 concurrent users access the system
When the system is under peak load
Then performance remains within accepted operational thresholds without degradation.

requirement_text: The system shall function reliably even with limited network coverage.
requirement_reference: "the app is developed so that it functions reliably even with limited network coverage."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want the app to function reliably with poor connectivity so that I can still use it in difficult network conditions.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given network coverage is limited
When I use the app
Then the app continues to function reliably for supported features.

requirement_text: The application shall undergo thorough testing before release to detect and resolve malfunctions early.
requirement_reference: "the app goes through a thorough testing and support process before release to detect and resolve any malfunctions early."

user_story.user_story:
As a product owner, I want the app thoroughly tested before release so that defects are found and resolved early.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a release candidate is prepared
When pre-release validation is performed
Then thorough testing is completed and identified malfunctions are tracked for resolution.

requirement_text: The application shall have a support process before release to detect and resolve malfunctions early.
requirement_reference: "the app goes through a thorough testing and support process before release to detect and resolve any malfunctions early."

user_story.user_story:
As a support stakeholder, I want a pre-release support process so that malfunctions can be addressed before launch.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given a release candidate is prepared
When the pre-release support process is executed
Then malfunctions are identified, supported, and resolved or escalated before release.

requirement_text: The system shall process all personal user data in compliance with GDPR.
requirement_reference: "All personal data of users are processed in compliance with the GDPR."

user_story.user_story:
As a user, I want my personal data processed in compliance with GDPR so that my privacy rights are protected.
Acceptance Criteria:
Given the app collects or processes personal data
When personal data is stored, used, or transmitted
Then the processing complies with GDPR requirements.
